scope: Targeted primary-source lookup and compatibility check of E-MTAB-6946, not an exhaustive atlas search or calibrated in-vivo cell proportion analysis.
secondary_annotation_sensitivity: After the primary three-library analysis and EmptyDrops annotation inspection, join explicit P15Clusters to already cached P15 cells by Library+Barcode. Test only the matched Zygotene group if >=20 cells, keep Leptotene untested if below this existing threshold. No EmptyDrops-only expression is available; do not replace primary annotations or claim all author Zygotene/Leptotene cells were processed.
required_evidence: Author per-cell annotations must be supplied independently of this project's expression fitting.
Cell count, metadata row order, gene order, and library/sample identities must reconcile with the author description and source files.
Exclude Tc1 and Tc0 transchromosomal-study samples from any normal developmental reference; do not treat Tc0 littermates as C57BL/6J wild types.
Keep author cell types, source sample names, library identifiers and age labels unchanged; no expression-based relabeling.
Human chromosome 21 features occur in the author's mixed reference genome: explicitly exclude human Ensembl features; do not merge cross-species symbols.
Inspect the CellRanger-selected author-labelled branch first; do not optimize filtering or choose cells based on fit quality.
Reuse frozen existing reference tables without marker tuning for initial compatibility diagnosis.
Pseudo-bulk profiles summarize captured cells, not independent animals or known tissue composition. No age p-values, causal composition percentages or fraction-accuracy claims.

retrieval.completeness: Targeted accession; reconcile retrieved declared files, not all database studies.
retrieval.download_cap_revision_before_fitting: The legacy compressed archive returned HTTP 404. The official current original matrix is 3,012,455,192 bytes; retrieve this declared file rather than an unaudited repackaging. A 6-minute transfer deadline and 3 GiB total cap apply.
retrieval.range_subset_before_fitting: Full transfer was stopped for insufficient throughput before fitting. Preselect complete libraries do17815 (adult B6), do26386 (P5) and do18195 (P15), not cells/genes selected by expression. Retrieve exact byte windows by column-sorted MatrixMarket boundaries; verify all selected cell totals and detected features. This is not the complete atlas.

prior_results: Keep all four published snapshots and their analysis sources unchanged. Save new work separately.
